subject: Quick note on Pace Print's website
bodyText:
Hi,

I'm Mani from Rogue.

We look for solid businesses that still look stuck online - and Pace Print stood out.

Edinburgh litho and digital printers on South Clerk Street since 1986 - and paceprint.co.uk still embeds a Macromedia Shockwave Flash menu, while the homepage still says you are now into our 26th year. Proper print shop; a shopfront frozen around 2012.

If useful, I'll send a short 3-point teardown over email - what's dated, what's costing you, and the first fix. No call required.

Reply YES and I'll send it.
